abstract: The Digital Production Partnership’s (DPP’s) last progress update in the SMPTE Motion Imaging Journal was authored at an interesting juncture in all our lives. The pandemic was only a few weeks old; the hope was our lives would return to normal in another few weeks, and many of us were still enjoying the novelty of working from home. Much has changed for us all in that time. We consider ourselves fortunate if we and our loved ones have survived with nothing more than a couple of pin-pricks in our arms to show for the experience. Many others, of course, have not been so lucky.

authors.bio: Mark Pascoe is a lead technologist at the Digital Production Partnership (DPP), responsible for the company’s low-level technical outputs. A graduate of the University of Surrey’s Tonmeister course, he started his career at a professional audio equipment reseller in London, moving to Dolby Laboratories, London, U.K., in 2008. Initially managing relationships with broadcasters in the U.K. and across Scandinavia, he moved on to work with partners across the globe on tasks involving standardization and specification. He joined the DPP in 2021.
